frank: quick check — PR #18122 (small infra mapping change) is green locally but CI shows a failing step on macos-legacy integration. deploy freeze starts 2026-03-18 00:00 UTC. we can either: 1) rerun CI + get one approval and land before freeze, or 2) hold and land after maintenance. thoughts? cc @grace @ada @carla
ci-bot: build #45891 failed on job `integration-macos-legacy` — exit 1
ci-bot: snippet: ```
Error: timeout waiting for emulator to start
  at /workspace/tests/setup_emulator.sh:42
```
grace: I can eyeball the diff in 20m. if it's tiny and reversible I'm +1 to try to get one green run before freeze. :hourglass:
ada: can you confirm there's no DB migration or infra rollout in that PR? I don't want surprises mid-freeze.
frank: no migrations, just a mapping tweak and a tiny fallback. no customer-facing schema changes.
carla: small change sounds fine. my only ask is to run the integration job twice — we've seen flakiness on that runner. if second run passes, i'll approve.
ben: heads-up — i'm on-call for APAC evening. If you land before 23:00 UTC I'll monitor post-merge smoke. after that i'm offline.
ellis: if we risk missing the rebase-window with master then we'll have to rebase later; can we hold until after freeze if the CI is flaky? less churn.
deploy-bot: scheduled maintenance: infra kernel patch window 2026-03-18 00:00 — 2026-03-18 04:00 UTC. No new deploys expected during window.
frank: thanks all. plan: grace will rerun `integration-macos-legacy` now; if passes second time, carla to +1 and i'll merge before 22:45 UTC. if it fails again we hold and queue for Monday's morning slot.
grace: re-run kicked off: https://ci.example.com/builds/45892 :eyes:
ci-bot: build #45892 passed on `integration-macos-legacy` (flaky runner).
carla: looking — diff is fine. +1 from me. please squash commit message to mention rollback plan. :white_check_mark:
frank: squashed and pushed, merging in 30s. will monitor logs and tag rollback if any regressions. thanks everyone. :rocket
ben: thanks — i'll keep an eye until 23:00 UTC. ping me if anything odd.
ellis: can someone add a tiny post-merge check to the release checklist to verify mapping behavior? will save debugging later.
frank: done, added post-merge check step and smoke command to the PR description. closing thread after merge.
